USE banking_analytics_db;

-- Top customers by balance
SELECT TOP 20
    customer_id,
    full_name,
    city,
    state,
    total_balance,
    total_loan_amount,
    total_card_outstanding,
    risk_score
FROM gold.vw_customer_360
ORDER BY total_balance DESC;

-- Fraud analysis
SELECT
    fraud_year,
    fraud_month,
    fraud_type,
    risk_level,
    fraud_count,
    total_loss,
    confirmed_frauds,
    confirmation_rate
FROM gold.vw_fraud_analysis
ORDER BY total_loss DESC;


-- Monthly financial performance
SELECT
    transaction_year,
    transaction_month,
    total_transactions,
    total_credits,
    total_debits,
    net_flow,
    upi_volume,
    netbanking_volume,
    rtgs_volume,
    imps_volume
FROM gold.vw_monthly_financial
ORDER BY
    transaction_year,
    transaction_month;
